description:
Configure advanced paragraph style definitions to automate the formatting of a City Council meeting transcript. 

Open '/home/ga/Documents/council_minutes_raw.odt', which contains raw text. 

1. Create a custom Paragraph Style named 'Speaker Label':
   - Font: Bold
   - Spacing: 6pt Above Paragraph
   - Flow: Enable 'Keep with next paragraph'
   - Next Style: Set to 'Minute Text'

2. Create a custom Paragraph Style named 'Minute Text':
   - Indentation: 0.5 inch (1.27 cm) Left Indent
   - Font: Regular (not bold)
   - Next Style: Set to 'Speaker Label' (creating a loop)

3. Apply these styles to the document content:
   - Apply 'Speaker Label' to all speaker names (lines ending in ':')
   - Apply 'Minute Text' to all dialogue paragraphs

4. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/council_minutes_formatted.odt'.
